title.narrative: CFYE Impact - Youth with decent employment

description.narrative: I.1 Number of young people (aged 15-35) to benefit from decent employmentEmployment may be part-time or full time, wage/salary-based or self-employment, formal or informal, provided that it meets the project's approved employment definition. A young person benefitting from decent employment may occur through matching, job creation or through improvement of existing employment. Counts the cumulative number of youth benefiting from employment via the three pathways as of the end of the reporting year.
